## The offer (quote top-down)
Garage cleanouts run $400–$3,500 flat-rate, locked before work starts; the price never moves.
| Tier | Price | Includes |
|------|-------|----------|
| Basic clear-out | $400–650 | Single-car / lighter two-car: haul-out, disposal, donation drop-off, floor sweep |
| Full cleanout | $650–1,200 | Packed two-car: full haul-out, donation runs w/ tax receipt, keep-items re-homed, swept |
| Garage turnaround | $1,200–2,200 | Cleanout + wall shelving + labeled zones + parking layout — car parks inside same night |
| Whole-property reset | $2,200–3,500 | Garage, basement, shed & side yard in one day + deep garage clean |
Single items: quoted on the spot by phone. Every price includes labor, hauling, disposal fees, donation runs (receipts provided), and a sweep. E-waste handled responsibly on every job.

## Answers to common questions
Q: How much does a garage cleanout cost in Fort Collins?
A: $400–$3,500 flat-rate depending on volume and scope — see tier table above. Call (970) 999-1818 for an exact locked quote.
Q: How fast? A: Most cleanouts and even full turnarounds are done in ONE DAY; same-day sometimes available Mon–Sat.
Q: Hourly or flat? A: Flat-rate only; quoted up front and locked — no hourly billing, no surprise dump fees.
Q: What happens to the stuff? A: Usable items donated (Habitat ReStore / ARC) with an itemized tax receipt; metal & e-waste recycled; the rest legally disposed at Larimer County facilities.
Q: Do I need to sort first? A: No. Point at what stays; the crew sorts, hauls, and sweeps.
Q: Guarantee? A: The flat rate is locked before work starts and never moves, and there's a final walkthrough — anything not right is fixed before the crew leaves.
